summary: Batched reinsertion defers handling root splits until all nodes have been reinserted. Multiple pending splits can then create an invalid tree with inconsistent leaf depths, causing sanity-check failures or insertion panics. The fix processes each reinsertion separately, immediately handles its root split, and updates the target height before the next reinsertion. The fix adds test_bulk_load_crash, which bulk-loads 40 three-dimensional points and checks tree invariants after each of 10 subsequent inserts. The proposed reversal restores only the parent insertion implementation, preserving the regression test and its sanity checks. No builds or tests were run.
